description: This Kotlin source file defines the AuthActivity class, which provides a simple in-memory authentication UI in an Android application. It handles user input for email and password, performs basic validation, and navigates to the main activity upon successful login or guest access.

classes.name: AuthActivity
classes.description: Android activity class providing a basic authentication UI with email and password inputs, validation, and navigation to the main application activity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and defines click handlers for login and guest actions.

methods.name: goToApp
methods.description: Starts the MainActivity and terminates the current authentication activity.
